supersedes_execution_of: ASV2-MINIMAL historical handoff (retained as benchmark only; do not execute unless ASV2-RICH fails its own data gate)
scientific_goal: Increase the information content of each synthetic Moroccan voter by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving historical pre-election leakage discipline and keeping F0 unchanged.

design_change.old_population: 128 IPF/maximum-entropy archetypes using a small set of marginal demographics
design_change.new_population: micro-founded synthetic voters seeded from anonymized HCP RGPH 2014 individual+household microdata, small-area reweighted to constituency marginals, then dynamically updated to each target election using only pre-target official statistics
design_change.reason: Avoid repeating E_reason's failure mode: strong protocol over an information set too sparse to express heterogeneous voter behavior.

source_layers.scope: 3,341,426 anonymized persons in 730,099 households; 85 variables according to HCP anonymisation documentation
source_layers.geography: microdata supports national/regional/provincial analysis; constituency localisation obtained by small-area reweighting against published commune/territory marginals

historical_use.2021: backbone aged/reweighted using only statistics published before election

source_layers.scope: communal individual and household indicators plus mobility/transport and profession/economic activity tables

historical_use.2021: base spatial structure with target-year official updates where available

source_layers.scope: 16,000-household national consumption survey and anonymized household/person microdata
source_layers.method: statistical matching onto RGPH synthetic households using covariates common to both sources; propagate imputation uncertainty
source_layers.forbidden: treat imputed household consumption as observed individual fact

source_layers.role: target-year labour-market reweighting and national economic context

historical_use.2021: 2020 annual and 2021 Q1 publications available before election

source_layers.variables: activity, employment, unemployment, underemployment, profession/sector where sourceable

source_layers.method: fit broad-demographic conditional distributions and sample synthetic latent attitudes; never copy respondents; no direct forthcoming-party vote intention in core arm

historical_use.2016: Wave III 2012-2014 only if item date precedes target cutoff

source_layers.method: use generic numeric attitude/context dimensions; exclude election-outcome or post-cutoff information and exclude direct forthcoming-party vote intention

source_layers.scope: already verified candidate identities and pre-election feature/event packets

socioeconomic_latent.epistemic_rule: posterior/imputed features must carry uncertainty and may be ablated separately

pre_election_attitudes.epistemic_rule: synthetic latent draws from pre-election anonymous national surveys, conditioned only on broad source-supported strata; never asserted as observed person facts

territory_national_context.historical_blinding: Use opaque IDs and generic standardized numeric context fields. Do not include distinctive event names, dates, leaders or prose that could reveal 2016/2021 to a model with historical memory.

population_synthesis.unit: weighted synthetic voter archetype / synthetic household member
population_synthesis.why_256: Richer joint state requires more support than 128 while remaining computationally manageable; 128 remains an ablation arm.
construction: Sample/cluster anonymized RGPH person-household records within the narrowest available geography.
Rake/calibrate weights to constituency-level published marginals without breaking within-record joint relationships.
For 2021, age/reweight the 2014 backbone using only pre-election HCP population projections and labour statistics.
Statistically match ENCDM socioeconomic variables with multiple imputation; retain uncertainty flags.
Attach anonymous survey-derived attitude latent states through demographic-stratum conditional models with multiple draws; do not attach real respondents.
Anchor political state to prior-election vote/abstention exactly as in the original protocol.
do_not: use direct party-vote intention in the core rich arm

ablation_arms: R0_MINIMAL_128: original six-ish-dimension electorate (sealed benchmark only)
R1_MICRODEMOGRAPHY: rich RGPH joint person/household state, no survey attitudes
R3_RICH_INDEPENDENT: R2 + pre-election latent attitude layer; primary rich independent-voter arm
R3_SHUFFLED_POLITICAL_CONTEXT: negative control with density-matched shuffled party/candidate context
R4_NETWORKED: only after R3 historical sanity passes; empirical/bounded social network interactions

execution_policy.next_action: Acquire/parse source codebooks and microdata, construct R1-R3 populations, run richness/power/leakage audit, then seal a new ASV2-RICH handoff.

rules: Use GitHub connector for one bulk discovery/read pass per phase, not file-by-file conversational browsing.
Perform joins, parsing, validation and artifact generation locally in /mnt/data.
Accumulate related repo edits into one consolidated commit where connector capabilities permit; otherwise keep to the smallest number of file writes.
Do not poll Actions repeatedly; trigger once and inspect only terminal job/result unless an actual failure needs logs.
Keep large raw public datasets outside Git history; commit manifests, hashes, scripts and derived compact artifacts only.
